data.name: GameOn!
data.detailed_description:
Summary / overview

Start and manage your very own game studio in GameOn!

Start as a solo game developer and work your way up to becoming a globally respected game studio with a massive fan base. Create games across multiple genres and manage a full studio of specialists and their needs. Build and manage your own game engines, hardware, online store and even merchandise your games. Take charge of the creative process by creating custom posters for every project and research new technology and features, follow market trends, analyze fan growth, and compete with rival studios for the #1 global ranking.

Key Features

  • Setup and manage your own Game Studio!

    Balance your finances, take loans if needed, maintain your server infrastructure, grow your digital store and research and unlock new possibilities. Every choice matters - your reputation, fanbase and income depend on your decisions!

  • Design and publish your dream games!

    Create games across multiple genres, gameplay features, target audiences, visual styles and platforms. Create new games, sequels or DLC content for earlier released games. Make crucial decisions during game development to find the perfect combination to match market trends and please your fanbase. Experience the thrill and hold your breath as reviewers deliver their verdict, directly impacting your sales!

  • Assemble and manage your dream team!

    Hire programmers, designers, animators, audio engineers, community managers and engineers. Train skills, negotiate salary, assign specialties, satisfy different needs, plan their vacations, prevent burnouts and keep morale high. If you fail they may resign entirely. 

  • Manage your studio with flexible policies!

    Control how your company behaves with adjustable policies:

    • Staff policies (vacation handling, toilet and coffee break, birthday celebration policies and more)

    • Environmental policies (amount of litter and hygiene policies)

    • Utilities policies (maintenance for coffee machines, printer and servers)

  • Generate custom posters for your games!

    Game projects generate a high resolution genre-themed poster, complete with: 

    • Random or custom-selected genre-themed backgrounds

    • Viewable and usable in-game

    • Placeable inside the studio as framed wall art

    • Exportable .PNG files to use outside the game (for social media or whatever you like!)

      Create your own Wall of Fame and display your entire game catalog in fully customizable frames!

  • Customization and endless gameplay!

    Customize your character, your studio's name and logo and rebrand at any time if you want to. Decorate your office with a free-forming system that allows you to place objects in 3D space and even scale objects. Place an interactable frame to set a game poster to display to create your own Wall of Fame.

    As long as you keep rolling in the money, you can remain in business forever!

Additional Features

  • Over 60+ custom soundtracks included.

  • Detailed analyses mechanics like financial and fan graphs.

  • Detailed history tracker for every project being released. 

  • Side contracts for extra income possibilities.

  • Seasonal decorations and random events. The choices you make directly impact your game studio. 

  • Employee of the year system. 

  • Utilities management (coffee corner, printer, server)

  • Cleaning management with environmental policies

  • Optional Game Reports: Deep analyses tool to gain additional insight in player choices during game development.

  • Optional tutorial system to help players in different areas while playing

  • UI color theme customization options

  • Extensive options for graphics, audio, gameplay and UI 

  • Multi-slot save / load support

Will you become the next rockstar of the gaming industry, or will your studio fade into obscurity? The world is watching - get ready to GameOn!

data.short_description: Build and manage your dream game studio! Create hit games, develop custom hardware, generate posters for each title, manage your team’s needs, decide on company policies, follow market trends, decorate your studio and see it in first-person! Your legacy starts now — GameOn!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
